scope: Privacy-preserving conversation summaries through the existing durable communication-email queue.
implementation: Only the newest noncancelled notification for a conversation can send while its message remains unread. New pending messages supersede older ones even before their ten-minute delay elapses; delivered newer jobs also suppress older leases. Separate conversations remain independent.

Delivery reads the current unread-count metadata after permission, block, verified-address, consent and exact-message checks. The email contains only that count and a generic app invitation, not decrypted content, ciphertext, author identity or conversation identifier.

The existing address-bound unsubscribe footer is preserved. The count is transient and is not written into queue bodies or returned through JSON. Existing retry, expiry and claim fencing remain in force.
Checks run immediately before external send, but a relationship/consent change after that point cannot retract an already in-flight provider request.
